create.name: Joel Cross
create.bio:
Joel Cross, known online as A Soul Called Joel, is a meditation teacher and musician based in Cleburne, Texas. Before turning to teaching he worked as a songwriter and guitarist, and his collaborations with the singer India.Arie earned him a Grammy nomination. He later trained as a meditation teacher with davidji, and music still runs through his work: many of his guided sessions are carried by his own guitar, and his reflections often draw on poetry and time spent outdoors.

His teaching is about coming home to the heart, learning to notice what is felt and to respond rather than react. He treats emotions as signals worth listening to, a theme he explores each week on his podcast, Emotional Evolution, which grew out of an earlier show called Hello Beautiful Souls. Most of his teaching happens in Beautiful Souls, an online membership with a live half-hour meditation every morning, weekly sharing circles and monthly workshops arranged in seasonal themes such as self-devotion. He also created the R.I.S.E. Journal, a guided practice of meditative journaling built on four steps, and sells self-paced meditation journeys of ten to thirty days. In 2027 he co-leads a week-long retreat with Dené Logan at Blue Spirit on Costa Rica's Pacific coast.

courses.title: Beautiful Souls Community
courses.description: His online membership: a live 30-minute meditation with Joel each weekday morning, weekly sharing circles and monthly workshops, organised into seasonal themes. Members also get the full archive of past sessions. Enrolment opens in seasons, with a waitlist between them.
courses.price: $39 USD a month or $349 USD a year

courses.title: Sacred Summer Camp (Blue Spirit, Costa Rica)
courses.description: An eight-day residential retreat in Nosara co-led with movement teacher Dené Logan. Days combine meditation and music with Joel, movement sessions, shared workshops, communal meals and free time by the ocean.

courses.title: The Heart of Authenticity
courses.description: A self-paced 30-day sequence of guided meditations on self-love and reconnecting with your true self, meant to be taken one day at a time.

courses.title: Calm & Connected
courses.description: A 30-day guided meditation journey focused on building a steady daily habit, with themes of clarity and self-awareness.

courses.title: Find Your Chill
courses.description: A shorter ten-day introduction to mindfulness meditation, moving through themes of calm, happiness, inspiration, love and liberation.

free_resources.title: Joel Cross on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Free guided meditations, affirmation practices and loving-kindness sessions, many set to his own guitar, plus short video meditations.

free_resources.title: Emotional Evolution podcast
free_resources.description: His weekly podcast, free on Spotify, Apple Podcasts and YouTube. Each episode pairs a short teaching on working with emotions with a practice to try.
